name: Microfacet BRDF with Simplified GGX and Schlick Fresnel
aliases: Walter et al. BRDF with Filament/Unreal simplifications
definition: A reflectance function R(x, ωi, ωo) defined for any 3D location x, incoming lighting direction ωi, and outgoing reflection direction ωo, incorporating simplifications from Filament and Unreal Engine renderers.
summary: A microfacet BRDF variant using simplified GGX and Schlick Fresnel terms, distinguished by non-standard separable forms enabling analytical factorization for neural rendering methods like NeRV.
